seo.title: Client work
seo.description: The platforms we built for clients: the role we held, the technical scope, the stack we used, and the public address you can open.
seo.detailDescription: {{name}} — {{category}}. The role we held, the technical scope and the stack we used. The product belongs to its client.

index.lede: These products belong to their clients. We state only the role we held, the stack we used and the address where you can see for yourself. A link you can open beats a number you have to take on faith.
index.emptyBody: The filter returns nothing. Clear it to get the full list back.
index.exitTitle: A product like these, but yours?
index.exitBody: This work shows what the studio can build. What comes next starts from your problem, not someone else's.

fiche.contextMissing: The repository holds no approved description for this project. We prefer this line to a sentence written to fill the gap.
fiche.roleNote: Every role listed is established from the project repository. What cannot be established there is not claimed.
fiche.scopeNote: Read from the project repository: dependency files, configuration, security rules.
fiche.nextStepBody: Tell us what you want to build. We answer with a written scope before any proposal.

authorization.title: What the client lets us publish
authorization.body: This page is published with its client's consent. That consent covers what can be checked from the outside, and nothing else.

granted.name: The product name and its sector
granted.stack: The stack we used, read from the repository
granted.liveLink: The public address, which you can open

withheld.results: No outcome achieved — the consent does not cover it
withheld.growthFigures: No growth, traffic or audience figure
withheld.contractTerms: No contractual information: amount, schedule, negotiated scope

debt.title: Two things are missing from this page
debt.body: The specification asks for the engagement length and a measurable outcome. The repository documents neither, and the publication consent does not cover the second. We do not invent them: their slots exist in the data, empty, and this page will show them as soon as a length is recorded and an outcome is publicly verifiable, sourced and cleared.
debt.footer: This panel disappears with the gap it names. That is what gives it an end.
